DeveloperController.description: The local developer over HTTP (127.0.0.1:7879): POST /developer/code, /test, /security, /document, /chat, /diagnose, /analyze and /plan. Each request runs on a thread of its own, so nothing of one request reaches the next.

routes.description: Why a step failed: `task` is the step, `context` its output, `path` the project's folder.
routes.name: diagnose

routes.description: Which kind of request a spec is and what its strategy asks of the run: before anything is generated or planned.
routes.name: analyze

Analysis.description: The strategy of a request (ADR-0105) and what it asks of the run: the stages that run, the generator calls (the arguments of `dragonfly gen`, each accepted by its dry run), the pieces the tools already gave (a piece with `code` is written as it is) and the facts the request lacks.
